tex_content.html:
Definition
[Characteristic map of a cell]

↗ def:cell-complex

\group CW Complexes

Each cell $e^n_\alpha $ has a characteristic map $\Phi _\alpha :D^n_\alpha \to X$ extending its attaching map and restricting to a homeomorphism from the disk interior onto $e^n_\alpha $.
